verdict.rationale: Cline's own GitHub README says that in JetBrains every edit appears as a diff you can review, modify or revert, which covers the interactive-diff half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents sharing selected code from the JetBrains editor as context; the general claim of 'the same Cline experience' does not establish it. Missing for 10: documented selected-code-to-context sharing in JetBrains, JetBrains-specific diff documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE

citations.quote: In VS Code and JetBrains, every edit shows up as a diff you can review, modify, or revert.
The same Cline experience in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, and the rest of the JetBrains family.
